plugins.name: tmux-pair
plugins.description: Spawn writer/reviewer agent pairs (or writer/reviewer/orchestrator triples) in fresh git worktrees, wired up via tmux. Includes the orchestration script, slash commands, the tmux-pair-orchestration skill, PROJECT.md care, scoped subagents for the gates, sender identity prefixes, explicit parallel-plan markers, shipped rules templates for 7 stacks, bundled companion skills (gepa for prompt-optimization, dg for adversarial code review), and pi as third coding agent alongside claude + codex.
